Serialise a release manifest to JSON

Source: R/release_manifest.R
manifest_json.Rd

Minimal, dependency-free JSON writer for manifests: named lists become objects, unnamed vectors of length > 1 arrays, NA/NULL null. Suitable for calib_run.manifest (jsonb) and JSON sidecars.

Usage

manifest_json(x, pretty = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A manifest from release_manifest() (or any list of scalars and named lists).

pretty

Logical: indent with two spaces.

Value

Character scalar.
